claims.statement: boundary: the byte before dt0 and the byte after the secret portion are not [A-Za-z0-9_.-] (Handoff boundary decision, not a provider statement. Read literally it would reject the URL-encoded OpenTelemetry header Authorization=Api-Token%20<token>, where the byte before dt0 is 0; that form is a documented transport, so it is authored as a positive and measures whether an implementation handles it. A .x glued after the token leaves a contract-valid token before the dot, so it is not authored as a twin (#84); the trailing-glue twin appends _x.)
